fields.label: Enable Task Management
fields.description: Enables or disables the custom task-management controls.

fields.label: Administration
fields.description: Global administration and privileged-access settings.

fields.label: Administrative Role
fields.description: Role with full task-management administration rights.

fields.label: Global Reopen Roles
fields.description: Legacy migration field; use the Role table above.

fields.label: Assignment Scope
fields.description: Controls assignable Employees using the reporting hierarchy.

fields.label: Scope Mode
fields.options:
Direct Reports Only
Full Reporting Tree
fields.description: Select direct reports only or the complete reporting tree.

fields.label: Maximum Hierarchy Depth
fields.description: Maximum reports_to levels traversed.

fields.label: Restrict to Same Company
fields.description: Restricts scope and assignment to the same Company.

fields.label: Allow Self Assignment
fields.description: Allows users to assign tasks to themselves.

fields.label: Outside Scope Policy
fields.options:
Block
Create Assignment Request
Administrative Role Only
fields.description: Policy for assignments outside the user hierarchy.

fields.label: Project Period
fields.description: Rules controlling Task dates against the Project period.

fields.label: Enforce Project Period
fields.description: Enforces Project date boundaries.

fields.label: Allow Before Project Start
fields.description: Allows Tasks to start before the Project.

fields.label: Allow After Project End
fields.description: Allows Tasks to start after the Project ends.

fields.label: Allow Crossing Project End
fields.description: Allows a Task to cross the Project end date.

fields.label: Allow Workplan Outside Period
fields.description: Allows Project Workplan Tasks outside Project dates.

fields.label: Missing Project Dates Policy
fields.description: Policy when Project dates are missing.

fields.label: Main and Child Tasks
fields.description: Main and child Task hierarchy settings.

fields.label: Allow Workplan as Main Task
fields.description: Allows Project Workplan Tasks as parents.

fields.label: Exclude Locked Main Tasks
fields.description: Excludes locked Tasks from parent selection.

fields.label: Maximum Task Tree Depth
fields.description: Maximum Task hierarchy depth.

fields.label: Lock Main Task When Children Exist
fields.description: Locks a parent Task when children exist.

fields.label: Require All Children Completed
fields.description: Requires all active children to be completed first.

fields.label: Rollup
fields.description: Controls child-to-parent rollup.

fields.label: Progress Calculation
fields.description: Parent progress calculation method.

fields.label: Roll Up Expected Hours
fields.description: Rolls child Expected Hours into the parent.

fields.label: Roll Up Actual Hours
fields.description: Rolls child Actual Hours into the parent.

fields.label: Sharing
fields.description: Managed Task sharing settings.

fields.label: Enable Managed DocShare
fields.description: Enables application-managed DocShare records.

fields.label: Share with Assignee
fields.description: Shares the Task with the assignee User.

fields.label: Share with Supervisor Chain
fields.description: Shares the Task with the supervisor chain.

fields.label: Managed Share Write Permission
fields.description: Legacy compatibility field. Managed supervisor shares are always read-only.

fields.label: Protect Manual Shares
fields.description: Preserves manual DocShare records.

fields.label: Remove Obsolete Managed Shares
fields.description: Removes obsolete application-managed shares only.

fields.label: Assignment Requests
fields.description: Task Assignment Request settings.

fields.label: Enable Assignment Requests
fields.description: Enables assignment requests and supervisor approval.

fields.label: Prevent Self Approval
fields.description: Prevents requesters from deciding their own requests.

fields.label: Notifications and Summary
fields.description: Notifications and scheduled summary settings.

fields.label: Enable Notifications
fields.description: Enables application Task notifications.

fields.label: Enable Weekly Summary
fields.description: Legacy setting; use the new schedule switch.

fields.label: Additional Weekly Recipients
fields.description: Legacy recipients field.

fields.label: Migration and Diagnostics
fields.description: Migration, reconciliation, and diagnostics.

fields.label: Migration Batch Size
fields.description: Migration batch size.

fields.label: Reconciliation Batch Size
fields.description: Reconciliation batch size.

fields.label: Warn About Legacy Scripts
fields.description: Warns about conflicting legacy scripts.

fields.label: Last Reconciliation On
fields.description: Last reconciliation time.

fields.label: Last Reconciliation Status
fields.description: Latest reconciliation status.

fields.label: Last Reconciliation Summary
fields.description: Latest reconciliation statistics.

fields.label: Main Task Must Belong to Same Project
fields.description: Requires parent and child Tasks to use the same Project.

fields.label: Allow Unassigned Standard Tasks
fields.description: Allows standard unassigned ERPNext Tasks.

fields.label: Roles Allowed to Reopen Globally
fields.description: System Roles allowed to reopen completed tasks globally.

fields.label: Scheduled Task Summary
fields.description: Configurable scheduled Task summary.

fields.label: Enable Scheduled Task Summary
fields.description: Enables scheduled summary delivery.

fields.label: Frequency
fields.description: Summary delivery frequency.

fields.label: Send Time
fields.description: Send time in the site timezone.

fields.label: Weekly Send Day
fields.options:
Monday
Tuesday
Wednesday
Thursday
Friday
Saturday
Sunday
fields.description: Delivery weekday for Weekly frequency.

fields.label: Monthly Send Day
fields.description: Monthly delivery day, 1–28.

fields.label: Additional Recipients
fields.description: Additional system or external recipients.

fields.label: Email Subject Template
fields.description: Fallback subject template.

fields.label: Email Template
fields.description: Editable Email Template for task summaries.

fields.label: Send to Assigned Employees
fields.description: Sends each employee their own summary.

fields.label: Last Period Key
fields.description: Internal duplicate-prevention key.

fields.label: Last Sent On
fields.description: Last actual summary send time.

fields.label: Next Scheduled Send
fields.description: Calculated next scheduled send.

fields.label: Last Send Status
fields.description: Status of the latest send attempt.

fields.label: Last Send Summary
fields.description: Technical result of the latest send run.

fields.label: Auto Calculate Expected Hours
fields.description: Auto-calculates Expected Hours from dates.

fields.label: Working Hours per Day
fields.description: Hours per day used by automatic calculation.

fields.label: Task Summary Period
fields.description: Controls the date range used to select Tasks for each summary.

fields.label: Report Period
fields.options:
Automatic by Frequency
Current Day
Current Week
Current Month
Previous Day
Previous Week
Previous Month
Custom Rolling Days
fields.description: Select the reporting period. Automatic follows the Daily, Weekly, or Monthly delivery frequency.

fields.label: Rolling Days
fields.description: Number of calendar days ending on the reference date.

fields.label: Include Carried-Forward Tasks
fields.description: Includes incomplete Tasks whose expected end date is before the report period.

fields.label: Include Tasks Without Dates
fields.description: Includes Tasks that do not have expected dates.

fields.label: Task Summary Filters
fields.description: Controls which Tasks are included in the email summary.

fields.label: Include Operational Tasks
fields.description: Includes non-group Tasks assigned to the Employee.

fields.label: Include Main Tasks
fields.description: Includes group Tasks in a separate section without double-counting their rolled-up hours.

fields.label: Include Project Workplan Tasks
fields.description: Includes Tasks marked as Project Workplan Tasks.

fields.label: Include Completed Tasks
fields.description: Includes completed Tasks whose completion date falls inside the selected period.

fields.label: Include Overdue Tasks
fields.description: Includes incomplete Tasks that are past their expected end date.

fields.label: Include Due Soon Tasks
fields.description: Includes incomplete Tasks due within the configured number of days.

fields.label: Due Soon Days
fields.description: Number of days used to classify a Task as due soon.

fields.label: Only Tasks Requiring Attention
fields.description: Includes only overdue, due-soon, stale, low-progress, or zero-hour Tasks.

fields.label: Progress Warning Threshold (%)
fields.description: Tasks below this progress are marked as requiring attention.

fields.label: Stale Task Days
fields.description: Tasks not modified within this many days are marked as requiring attention.

fields.label: Exclude Zero-Hour Tasks
fields.description: Excludes Tasks whose Expected Hours are zero.

fields.label: Optional Filter Values
fields.description: Optional filters for Status, Priority, Task Type, and Project. Leave empty to include all values.

fields.label: Task Summary Display
fields.description: Controls the amount of detail and the columns shown in the email.

fields.label: Report Detail Level
fields.options:
Summary Only
Summary and Attention Tasks
Full Task Details
fields.description: Select whether the email contains KPIs only, attention Tasks, or full Task details.

fields.label: Maximum Tasks per Section
fields.description: Maximum number of rows shown in each email section.

fields.label: Task Reopen Policy
fields.description: Controls who can reopen a completed task. Access is always checked against the specific task.
